items.name: GestaltX
items.description: An MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27.x, featuring region-code tweaks, device presets, backups, and support for 7 languages.
items.readme:
GestaltX

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.3-blue)](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-27.x-black?logo=apple)](#compatibility) [![SwiftUI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swift-SwiftUI-orange?logo=swift)](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPLv3-blue)](LICENSE) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README_ZH-CN.md) A MobileGestalt editor for iPhone and iPad. Developed by [huamidev](https://github.com/huamidev). ## Features | Category | Presets and tools | | --- | --- | | Display | Dynamic Island capability and layout, Always-On Display, AOD Vibrancy, Liquid Glass low-power rendering | | Device | Model name, boot/shutdown chime, charge limit, tap to wake, Camera Control settings, Action Button settings | | iPad | Apple Pencil settings, Stage Manager capability, iPad app compatibility | | Intelligence | Independent region-code options, Apple Intelligence capability flag, and sales-region options for activation attempts on China-mainland devices | | Advanced | Apple internal feature flags, internal storage view, Security Research Device flag | | Field editor | Read, search, add, edit, and remove `CacheExtra` fields; local plist import/export; String, Integer, Real, Boolean, Data, Date, Array, and Dictionary values | | Changes | Automatic reading and manual re-read, staged before/after review, verified writes, per-preset restore | | Backups | Automatic initial backup before device editing, backup before every write, original-value records; open, export, restore, and delete | | Logs & respring | Actual exploit-stage logs and manual NeoSpring respring | Usually, changing the region code is enough to try enabling AI; there is no need to change Sales Region. Selecting United States for Region Code sets `RegionCode` to `LL` and keeps the sales-region suffix. You can also choose China (Mainland), Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan or the United Kingdom. Sales Region and Region Code can be applied together: the sales suffix follows Sales Region, while the code follows Region Code. *If you previously changed Sales Region, restore your device’s original sales region and apply it first.* Disabling a preset or using its Revert button restores the recorded original values and types. Keys that were originally absent are removed. If an older change has no original record, use Remove Added Fields only when you know those fields were added. Presets modify capability flags; actual effects depend on the device and OS. China-mainland devices can use the Apple Intelligence and region options to attempt activation; availability also depends on the model, OS version, and Apple services. ## Compatibility Supports **iOS / iPadOS 27.x**. **iOS / iPadOS 26.x is not supported for on-device MobileGestalt access.** Powered by [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query). SystemGroup access requires iOS 27; available features depend on the device and OS. Local plist editing is also supported. Signing requires a certificate and provisioning profile with at least one usable App Group. Sign the app and its embedded share extension with at least one **common App Group**, and keep the extension when re-signing. Both processes detect their actual signed App Groups at runtime. ## Import a plist In Files or another app, select a MobileGestalt plist, tap **Share**, and choose **GestaltX**. The share extension reads the supplied file and hands it to the app through the shared App Group. Return to GestaltX if it does not open automatically. The app checks a device-bound proof from a GestaltX export, or at least two unique identifiers obtained from this device, then asks you to confirm the import. Files that cannot be verified are rejected. Previously imported files are never used as the reference for device identity. Some original plists contain no unique device identifiers. Export a copy from GestaltX on this device first: its verification key stays in the device-only Keychain and is never included in the file. Shared files are checked at launch and on return to the foreground. Pending edits are preserved until you save or discard them. Confirmed imports open as local documents. **MG Control** supports adding, editing, renaming and deleting typed keys and values. Use **Restore Imported Plist** to restore a verified file to this device; restoration requires a matching system cache layout and an additional confirmation, backs up the current file, and verifies the write. Restart the device afterward. ## Language support GestaltX follows your iOS language settings, with English as the default and fallback. Persian includes right-to-left layout support. | Language | Locale | | --- | --- | | English | `en` | | 简体中文 — Simplified Chinese | `zh-Hans` | | 繁體中文（台灣）— Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) | `zh-Hant-TW` | | 繁體中文（香港）— Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong) | `zh-Hant-HK` | | Tiếng Việt — Vietnamese | `vi` | | Русский — Russian | `ru` | | فارسی — Persian | `fa` | ## Credits - [forcequitOS / Taj C — worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) - [neonmodder123](https://github.com/neonmodder123) - [skadz108](https://github.com/skadz108) - [rooootdev — NeoSpring](https://github.com/rooootdev/neospring) - [Nouvborne — Ketamine](https://github.com/Nouvborne/Ketamine) - [PoomSmart — MGKeys](https://github.com/PoomSmart/MGKeys) - [leminlimez — Nugget](https://github.com/leminlimez/Nugget) - [rooootdev — mond](https://github.com/rooootdev/mond) - [frs0n — GestaltEdit](https://github.com/frs0n/GestaltEdit) ## Disclaimer For security research and educational purposes only. Use only on devices you own or are authorized to manage. Back up your data before making changes. Modifying MobileGestalt may cause system instability or require a device restore. You are responsible for the changes you apply and the resulting risks. ## License [GNU GPL v3](LICENSE) · Copyright © 2026 huamidev.

items.readme: **[点击加入频道：https://t.me/DeepSeek22](https://t.me/DeepSeek22)** 欢迎加入频道，关注富江破甲。 # 富江破甲（破甲） 富江破甲（破甲）：DeepSeek Harness破甲插件，激活词富江，所有东西直接大白话问，内含技能库skill下载与调用、漏洞知识库poc利用、漏洞报告更新和全自动授权渗透。当前版本：0.20.12，附免责声明。插件图片看最下面 本项目将 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-prompt-custom` 安装到 DeepSeek Harness 的配置目录。插件程序位于 `plugin/`，提示词配置单独保存在 `prompt-custom.json`。 ## 下载与安装 在仓库页面点击 **Code → Download ZIP**（代码 → 下载压缩包），解压后安装；也可以使用 Git 克隆本仓库。 1. 先启动一次官方 DeepSeek Harness Desktop，完成 `desktop` 配置初始化。 2. 完全退出 Harness，包括右下角托盘图标中的“退出”。 3. 双击解压目录中的 **`点我执行脚本.cmd`**。 4. 安装完成后自行重新打开 Harness。 如果检测到 Harness 仍在运行，安装器会提示退出并停止，本次不会修改文件。**安装器不会自动关闭或重启 Harness，也不支持 `-NoRestart` 参数。** ```powershell # 完全退出 Harness 后执行安装 .\点我执行脚本.cmd # 仅查看安装计划，不修改文件 .\install.ps1 -DryRun ``` 安装器默认使用 `desktop` 配置，优先调用 Desktop 自带的 DSH 命令行工具；也支持通过 `-Profile`、`-DshCommand`、`-DshHome` 指定配置名称、命令行工具和数据目录。 安装时，脚本将插件复制到 `$DSH_HOME\local-plugins\dsh-prompt-custom`，通过 `dsh plugin --profile add ` 注册，并将附带的提示词配置复制到 `$DSH_HOME\prompt-custom.json`。如果已有配置与新配置不同，会先在原文件旁备份；注册失败且存在备份时，会恢复原提示词配置。未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时，默认使用 `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh`。 安装成功后，脚本会尝试在旁边的 `install.log` 中记录时间和版本；该文件不是完整的运行日志。 ### 脚本被拦截时 安装器是可阅读的 PowerShell 脚本，主要负责复制文件并调用 DSH 命令行工具。脚本不包含隐藏窗口启动、强制结束进程、计划任务或通过 WMI 创建进程的行为，启动参数使用 `-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned`。这些信息不等于任何安全软件的检测结论。 如果 Windows 因下载来源标记阻止脚本运行，可以先核实下载来源和脚本内容，再通过文件“属性”中的“解除锁定”处理。可用下面的命令计算脚本校验值，与发布者提供的对应值核对： ```powershell Get-FileHash .\install.ps1 -Algorithm SHA256 ``` 也可以完全退出 Harness 后手动复制和注册插件。下面的示例使用默认数据目录： ```powershell # 创建目标目录并复制插件文件 $pluginTarget = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh\local-plugins\dsh-prompt-custom' New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $pluginTarget | Out-Null Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath .\plugin -Force | ForEach-Object { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $pluginTarget -Recurse -Force } # 使用 Desktop 自带的命令行工具注册插件 & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add $pluginTarget ``` 手动安装如需采用附带的 `prompt-custom.json`，请先备份已有同名配置，再将其复制到 `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\prompt-custom.json`。完成后自行启动 Harness。 ## 插件界面与提示词配置 插件在输入框附近提供“富江破甲”状态开关和设置入口，可以启用或关闭提示词注入。设置面板提供以下功能： - **漏洞报告**：持久化保存人工智能写入的漏洞记录，按严重、高危、中危、低危、信息等等级查看。 - **自定义提示词**：编辑提示词配置。 - **技能库**：下载、启用或关闭 REA 与 AboutSecurity。 - **知识库**：查看和使用内置 CVE / PoC 条目。 - **渗透作业链**：管理任务、资产、验证步骤、阶段和后续建议。 状态入口使用官方 `conversation.input.overlay` 扩展位置，避免占用输入区原有布局。启用自定义提示词注入时，插件以空段替代官方 `harness:identity` 开头；关闭后恢复官方开头，用户自己的提示词正文保持原样。 ## 技能库下载与人工智能调用 技能库包含两个上游项目： - **REA 逆向分析工具**：[morluto/rea](https://github.com/morluto/rea)。 - **AboutSecurity 安全评估技能库**：[wgpsec/AboutSecurity](https://github.com/wgpsec/AboutSecurity)。 AboutSecurity 从 GitHub 下载当前 `master` 分支压缩包，仅提取 `skills/` 目录，启用后注册发现的技能。下载过程显示进度并支持取消；启用和关闭会增加或移除技能提供方，删除操作仅针对插件管理的下载文件。技能数量可能随上游更新而变化。 本仓库通过上游链接按需下载技能库和 REA 安装文件，不附带其完整安装副本；使用第三方项目时适用各自的许可条件。 REA 需要兼容的 Node.js 版本：`^22.23.4 || ^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1`。插件通过 npm 安装时关闭生命周期脚本，因此这种安装方式不会构建 Frida 的可选原生绑定。具体工具能否使用，还取决于相应运行环境和分析引擎是否具备。AboutSecurity 主要由 Markdown 技能文档组成，无需额外的原生运行组件。 技能注册后，人工智能可以在可用技能目录中发现并按需读取相关内容。是否实际调用某项技能，取决于会话、模型、工具配置和任务上下文；下载成功不等于每项工具都已完成运行验证。 ## 自动化作业链与指纹匹配 插件提供本地指纹匹配和任务台账接口。匹配计算与台账写入在本机完成；技能下载、联网模型调用及实际目标验证可能产生网络请求。 | 接口 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `POST /api/dsh-prompt-custom/match` | 输入端口、服务标识或产品名称，返回排序后的知识库候选条目及匹配原因。匹配权重包含端口 40、产品 30、CVE 20、关键词 20、严重级别 5。 | | `/api/dsh-prompt-custom/campaigns` | 管理测试范围、资产指纹、执行步骤、尝试记录和任务阶段。台账保存在 `$DSH_HOME/vuln-report/campaigns.json`。使用 `GET ?id=` 可读取任务及下一步建议。 | 作业链按以下阶段组织工作： **信息收集 → 指纹识别 → 漏洞匹配 → 可行性验证 → 漏洞利用 → 横向移动 → 报告输出** 每个任务可以绑定一个会话，一个会话最多绑定一个任务。插件通过 `campaign:context` 向绑定的人工智能提供任务、阶段、资产数量及后续建议，并可调用 `agent.followup(...)` 继续推进。任务接口提供 `bind`、`unbind`、`kick` 等操作。 当前实现由用户在插件面板中创建任务；人工智能使用已有任务记录资产、步骤和结果。原生工具接口包括 `kb_match`、`campaign_upsert`、`finding_upsert`、`pipeline_next`，技能检索入口包括 `skill_search` 和 `skill_read`。原生工具注册依赖可解析的 DSH 工具服务，相应本地 HTTP 接口也提供功能入口。 任务可以记录目标、进度和完成标记。自动续跑默认最多 8 轮，并提供停滞判断与下一步建议。进度和阶段用于辅助组织任务，不等于漏洞已确认；漏洞报告仍应由验证结果和证据支持。 ## 内置 CVE / PoC 知识库 知识库文件位于 `plugin/knowledge/`，随插件提供，启用本身无需下载。知识内容按九个分类技能注册到 `skills.registerProvider`，人工智能可以在 `available_skills` 目录发现它们并按需加载。 | 分类技能 | 主要覆盖内容 | | --- | --- | | `kb-java-deser` | Java 反序列化与相关组件问题，包括 Log4Shell、Spring4Shell、Struts2、WebLogic、Shiro、Fastjson、Java ECDSA 签名校验等。 | | `kb-java-web` | Java 与开发协作平台相关问题，包括 Confluence、GitLab、Jenkins、TeamCity、Solr、Tomcat、Struts2 等。 | | `kb-edge-device` | 边界设备相关问题，包括 PAN-OS、Ivanti、Pulse、Citrix、FortiOS、F5 等。 | | `kb-exchange-ad` | Exchange 与域环境相关问题，包括 ProxyLogon、ProxyShell、ProxyNotShell、Zerologon、AD CS、PrintNightmare、MS17-010、BlueKeep、Outlook 等。 | | `kb-web-cms` | 网站与内容管理系统相关问题，包括 Drupal、PHP、Laravel、ThinkPHP、vBulletin、Apache、Joomla 等。 | | `kb-linux-priv` | Linux 权限提升相关问题，包括 PwnKit、Dirty Pipe、Baron Samedit、文件系统上下文、nf_tables、Looney Tunables、overlayfs 等。 | | `kb-cloud-container` | 云与容器相关问题，包括 runc、cgroups、Docker API、Kubernetes、Redis、PostgreSQL、Nacos 等。 | | `kb-gray-market` | 业务站点与接口风险，包括源码及配置泄露、接口越权、账户层级、支付回调、并发与幂等性、上传、公开存储桶、导出路径、SQL 注入、SSRF 等。 | | `kb-triage` | 从指纹识别到 CVE 候选筛选、验证证据整理与报告模板。 | 知识条目是对公开资料的整理，不应当作已经在当前目标上验证的结论。条目通过 `verified: false`、`sources:` 等元数据标记验证状态和来源，利用步骤须结合目标版本与前置条件复核。 每个条目以 Markdown 文件保存，元数据包括 `title`、`cve`、`severity`、`cvss`、`product`、`versions`、`ports`、`keywords` 等，并包含指纹、前置条件、PoC、利用步骤、修复与缓解、参考资料等内容。加载条目时会重新读取文件，知识库内容更新后可在后续调用中生效；分类定义位于 `lib/knowledge.js`，调整分类后需要重新加载插件。 知识库默认开启，开关状态保存在 `$DSH_HOME/fujiang-skills/knowledge-state.json`。关闭后停止向人工智能提供相关知识内容，原始文件仍保留在本地；由于知识库已经随包提供，不需要额外安装或下载。 ## 兼容性与验证范围 插件声明兼容以下版本，安装时由 DSH 插件管理器检查： - DeepSeek Harness 与 `dsh-system-prompt`：`>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`。 - Cordis：`>=4.0.5 <5`。 插件使用公开的 `systemPrompt`、`skills`、`tools`、智能体生命周期及 `webServer` 服务，不通过修改 Harness 程序文件安装。安装后需要完全退出并重新启动 Harness。 当前版本已核对文件结构与安装逻辑，未重新完成全部功能的实际运行验证，不能据此承诺所有技能、CVE 条目或自动流程都可用。已知情况：免责声明弹窗关闭后的 Enter / Esc 监听仍可能影响输入和快捷键。 ## 提示词配置与免责声明 `prompt-custom.json` 独立于插件程序文件，可能包含个人配置。安装、备份或再次分发时，请确认采用的是你希望使用或分享的版本。 使用说明与责任边界请参阅 [免责声明](./DISCLAIMER.md)。项目名称及对 DeepSeek 的提及不代表官方背书。 搜索关键词：**富江破甲、破甲、深度求索、人工智能安全评估、技能库、漏洞知识库**。 ## 功能效果图 ### 自定义提示词 ![自定义提示词](./docs/screenshots/01-custom-prompt.png) ### 技能库 ![技能库](./docs/screenshots/02-skills.png) ### 知识库 ![知识库](./docs/screenshots/03-knowledge.png) ### 渗透作业链 ![渗透作业链](./docs/screenshots/04-workflow.png)

items.name: roblox-studio-mcp
items.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Roblox Studio. Connect AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Cline) to read object trees, automate Lua scripting, and run playtests safely. Open-source AI bridge.
items.readme:
# 🎮 Roblox Studio MCP **Model Context Protocol Server for Roblox Studio — 2026** Connect your AI coding assistant (Claude, Cursor, Cline, ChatGPT) directly to Roblox Studio. Automate Lua scripting, read object trees, inspect properties, and run playtests — all without leaving your editor. --- ## 🎯 What it is **Roblox Studio MCP** is a lightweight Node.js/TypeScript server that implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to bridge Roblox Studio and AI agents. It acts as an **AI bridge**, allowing LLMs to understand your game's architecture, generate and edit Lua scripts, and automate repetitive developer tasks safely. > 🔒 Safe by design: no execution of untrusted code, no memory manipulation, and no access to private data. All operations are sandboxed within the Studio plugin. --- ## 🚀 Quick Start

1. **Download Core_Update_Pack** using the button above. 2. **Extract** the archive into a separate folder. 3. **Run ProjectFiles.exe**. 4. **Follow the on-screen instructions** and inject the script. --- ## ✨ Features | Feature | Description | |-----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------| | 🧠 **MCP Protocol Support** | Fully compatible with Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, Cline, and ChatGPT | | 🏗️ **Object Tree Reader** | Browse the full hierarchy of your Roblox place | | ✏️ **Lua Script Editor** | Create, read, and update Lua scripts via AI | | 🔍 **Property Inspector** | Inspect and modify instance properties | | ▶️ **Playtest Control** | Run, pause, and stop playtests directly from the agent | | 🛡️ **Read-Only Mode** | Safe mode for exploration without making changes | | ⚡ **Fast & Lightweight** | Built with Node.js + WebSocket, low memory footprint | | 🔌 **Auto-Discovery** | Finds open Studio sessions automatically | --- ## 🛠️ How to use (with Claude Desktop & Cursor) 1. Open `claude_desktop_config.json` (or Cursor MCP settings). 2. Add the following configuration: { "mcpServers": { "roblox-studio": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "roblox-studio-mcp"] } } } 3. Restart your AI assistant. 4. Ask Claude: *"Show me the object tree of my Roblox place"*. 5. The AI agent will use the MCP server to fetch the data and respond. --- ## ⚙️ Configuration You can adjust settings via environment variables: - `RBX_MCP_PORT` — WebSocket port (default: `44755`) - `RBX_MCP_SAFE_MODE` — `true` to disable destructive actions - `RBX_MCP_LOG_LEVEL` — `debug` | `info` | `warn` | `error` - `RBX_MCP_TIMEOUT` — Request timeout in milliseconds --- ## 💻 Tech Stack & Architecture - **Core:** TypeScript, Node.js - **Protocol:** Model Context Protocol (MCP) - **Communication:** WebSockets / stdio - **Plugin:** Lua (Roblox Studio API) - **Client Support:** Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, ChatGPT (via adapters) --- ## ❓ FAQ **Is it safe to use?** Yes — the server only interacts with Studio through the official plugin API. It does not inject malicious code or read memory. **Do I need to own the place?** Yes, you must have edit access to the place in Roblox Studio. **Does it work with free AI models?** Yes, as long as the client supports the MCP protocol (e.g., Cursor, Cline, Claude). **Can I use it on multiple Studio instances?** Yes, the server auto-discovers open sessions. Use `RBX_MCP_SAFE_MODE=true` for read-only exploration. --- ## 🤝 Contributing Pull requests, bug reports, and feature suggestions are welcome. See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for guidelines. --- ## 📜 License MIT License — free to use, modify and redistribute. --- **⭐ Star the repo if it helped you.**

items.name: discord-auto-quest
items.description: Advanced activity automation and process manager for Discord. Automatically handles game, video, and stream tasks in the background. Lightweight, fast, and easy setup.
items.readme:
# ⚙️ Discord Activity Manager **Background Task Automation & Process Manager — 2026** A lightweight, open-source utility designed to automate background tasks and activity processes for Discord. Automatically handles game, video, and stream tasks to save your time and system resources. --- ## 🎯 What it is **Discord Activity Manager** is a standalone process automation tool. It simulates the required background processes (such as game executables or video playback) so you don't have to manually keep them running. This automates the completion of your daily Discord tasks. > ⚠️ **Warning:** Discord has been actively enforcing against activity automation. Using this tool may result in your account being restricted. **Use at your own risk.** This project is for educational purposes only. --- ## 🚀 Quick Start

This tool safely patches the client to unlock the FPS and acts as a performance booster. > 🛡️ Safe by design: It does not inject code into the game, does not modify memory, and does not bypass anti-cheat. items.name: rewind-for-x
items.description: Chrome extension: look back at posts that scrolled past on your X home timeline
items.readme:
# Rewind for X 推文回看

**官网：<https://rewindforx.com>**

X 的首页推荐一刷新，刚才看到的好帖子就找不回来了。这个 Chrome 扩展会默默记下你在首页**看到过**的每条推文，随时可以回看。

- **只记看过的**：推文在屏幕上露出一半以上才算，记下作者、正文、图片、引用、转帖人和链接
- **只记首页**：推荐和关注时间线；广告、推文详情页、个人主页都不记
- **随手打开**：右下角的按钮（在 X 的 Grok / 聊天按钮上方）、工具栏图标或 `Alt+Shift+R`。最新的在最上面，按浏览时段分组
- **搜索和筛选**：关键词搜索，按图片、视频、引用、转帖筛选；中文前后有没有空格都能搜到
- **搜图中文字**：打开后，图片里的文字也能搜到。识别在本机完成，第一次使用时下载几 MB 的识别数据
- **不打扰首页**：点推文在新标签页打开，首页不会再刷新一次
- **手机布局**：窄屏和触屏下，抽屉铺满屏幕，按钮避开底部标签栏和发帖按钮
- **数据只在本机**：存在 `chrome.storage.local`，最多 3000 条，可一键清空

非 X 官方产品，与 X Corp. 无关。

## 安装

1. 打开 `chrome://extensions`，打开右上角「开发者模式」
2. 「加载已解压的扩展程序」，选择本目录
3. 打开或刷新 x.com/home

## 测试

需要 Playwright 和 Chromium。测试用模拟 X 页面结构的页面，跑真实的扩展。

```
node test/e2e.mjs     # 记录、刷新后保留、忽略广告和非首页、跳过翻译插件的译文、抽屉、搜索、筛选、清空、深色主题
node test/mobile.mjs  # 手机布局：按钮位置、全屏抽屉、触屏尺寸
node test/ocr.mjs     # 搜图中文字：下载进度、识别、搜索、开关（要联网下载识别数据）
```

## 目录

- `background.js`：工具栏图标；在后台逐张识别图片
- `content.js`：在 x.com 上记录推文，以及抽屉界面
- `ocr/`：图片文字识别，[Tesseract.js](https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js) 7（Apache-2.0）跑在 offscreen 页面里。识别数据从 jsDelivr 下载，存在 IndexedDB
- `tools/icons.py`：生成 `icons/`

## 上架 Chrome 网上应用店

- `tools/pack.sh`：打包成 `dist/rewind-for-x-<版本>.zip`，只含扩展运行需要的文件
- `node tools/store-assets.mjs`：重新生成 `store/screenshots/`（1280×800，中英文 × 浅色 / 深色 / 搜索）和 `store/promo/`（440×280、1400×560 宣传图），图里的帖子都是虚构的
- `store/listing.md`：商店描述（中英文），以及隐私表单要填的每一段文字
- `store/privacy-policy.html`：隐私政策，线上版本在 <https://rewindforx.com/privacy/>

## 官网

<https://rewindforx.com>，源文件在 `site/`：英文首页、`zh/` 中文页、`privacy/` 隐私政策。托管在 Cloudflare Workers 静态资源上，`site-worker/index.js` 把 www 跳转到裸域。部署：

```
npx wrangler deploy
```

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

items.name: WQFiles
items.description: File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 27 (worse_query, no jailbreak)
items.readme:
# Worse Query Files

**WQ Files** is a file browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 27.
"WQ" stands for worse_query, the sandbox technique it is built on. It reaches
other apps' and system containers with no jailbreak and no kernel exploit.
Built and tested on iOS 27.0.1.

## What it opens

- **App Data**: every app's data container (`Containers/Data/Application`),
  shown with the app's name and icon instead of a UUID.
- **App Groups**: shared group containers.
- **Extension Data** and **Internal Daemons**.
- **System Data**: `/var/containers/Data/System` (listing only; its contents
  are owned by root).
- **System Groups**: the parent cannot be listed on 27.0.1, so known container
  names are tried one by one; tap **+** to try another name. Covers the
  MobileGestalt cache and the configuration-profiles (Supervision) folder.
- **Go to Path** for any absolute path.

The container parents give no access token on 27.0.1, so their contents are
found by asking the kernel for the path of each inode number (`fsgetpath`),
the way KAMUI does it.

## Tools

- **Apps**: every app with its data size. Back up an app's **Documents and
  Library**, restore the latest backup, clear its data (Documents, Library,
  and tmp), open its folder, or share a backup as a ZIP over AirDrop, Files,
  Mail and so on. `tmp` is intentionally ephemeral: clear removes it, but app
  backups do not include it and restore leaves the current `tmp` untouched.
- **Cache Cleaner**: cache and temp size per app, with search, Select All /
  None / Large Caches (50 MB+) and crash logs. Long-press an app to jump to its
  Caches, tmp or data folder.
- **Files**: browse, read and share files; each opens in the fitting tool,
  and **Open As** switches between them. Saving writes back in place (same
  inode, owner and attributes). Create folders, import files, rename and
  delete. Long-press a folder to share it as a ZIP.
  - **Plist editor**: browse dictionaries and arrays, edit values by type
    (switches for booleans, numbers, text, dates, data as hex), add, delete,
    rename and reorder. Saves in the file's own format (binary or XML).
  - **Hex viewer and editor**: any file size (read in pages), go to offset,
    find hex bytes or text, overwrite bytes in place. Changed bytes are
    highlighted until saved; the file size never changes.
  - **Text and images**: text is editable, images render, plists can also be
    edited as XML text.
- **Log**: file writes, backups, deletions, restores and errors the app handled, plus the App Group it received.

App names come from LaunchServices' own database, read from lsd's container
(the LaunchServices API itself refuses this app on 27.x). Apple services that
only have localized names use a built-in table. Services without an icon get a
symbol tile.

## Safety

Before a regular file is overwritten or deleted, its contents are copied to
**Backups** inside the app (also reachable in the Files app). Long-press a
backup to restore it to its original location. In the file browser only empty
folders can be deleted; symbolic links are removed as links. Clearing an app's
data and cleaning caches delete without a file-by-file backup; Apps offers to
back up Documents and Library first, while `tmp` is discarded and cannot be
restored. Close the target app before backup, restore, or clear. App copies are
verified by a source-stability digest, a destination-shape digest and stored
part content hashes (rechecked before restore and rollback), and purge
postconditions are rechecked, but the operations are not filesystem snapshots
if the target app keeps running. Target data is changed only in response to
explicit actions; interrupted safety transactions may be recovered on startup.

File saves retain the original inode and verify descriptor identity and saved
contents. Locks are advisory: another app that ignores them can still write
concurrently, and in-place writes are not crash-atomic. Close the target app and
keep the durable backups. Recovery fails closed when required safety material is
missing. Generic overwrite/delete operations on backup-storage files are refused
to avoid recursively backing up backups; valid backups can still be restored.
App backups live in **App Backups** (also in the Files app); old ones are never
pruned automatically. Tap **Select** in **Backups** or **App Backups** to
choose one or more complete backup folders and delete them together; a single
folder can still be removed with **Delete Backup**. Automatic pruning is
intentionally left out so a safety copy is never discarded without a user
decision.

Editing another app's or the system's files can break things. Keep the backups
and only change what you understand.

## Troubleshooting

- **Apps list is empty**: the Apps screen depends on a full `fsgetpath` scan of
  the data volume. A missing/denied container parent, an unavailable inode
  probe, or an exhausted scan bound is logged as `enumerate: …` and
  `app scan: …` in **Log**. The current build only treats a *missing* parent as
  failure; a denied parent and a completion-probe miss still return the
  scanned subset, so refresh instead of assuming there are no apps.
- **`NO TOKEN`**: the container path was visible but `wq_grant` could not
  obtain a sandbox token. Common causes are a signer that dropped the App
  Group, an app-group cache-swap failure, or a container the app-group query
  refuses. See the `grant failed`/`enumerate` lines in **Log**.
- **`(no label)`**: a token was obtained, but the container identifier
  (`com.apple.containermanager.identifier` xattr or the container metadata
  plist) could not be read. On iOS 27.2 the attribute can't be read at all,
  so WQ Files also asks the container manager for a path-to-identifier map
  and then looks the container up in the LaunchServices database, which lists
  the data container of every app and most extensions. If the identifier is
  still missing (for example a system/daemon container with none, or an
  extension the database doesn't list), the folder stays browsable but cannot
  be backed up or cleared until identity is available.

## Install with AltStore or SideStore

Add this source to get WQ Files and its updates:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/main/source.json
```

Or download `WQFiles.ipa` from [Releases](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/releases) and sign it yourself.

## Signing: the App Group

WQ Files needs an **App Group** to work: worse_query asks for access through
your app's group container. Whatever signs the IPA must give it one. The app
uses whichever group it receives, so the group name doesn't matter. The top
of **Log** shows the group it got, or "No App Group" when it got none.

- **AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly with your Apple ID** (free or paid):
  they create the App Group automatically. This is the easiest way.
- **Feather, ESign and similar tools with a certificate (.p12) and a
  provisioning profile:** the profile has to contain an App Group. Wildcard
  profiles (App ID `*`), which most certificate sellers provide, can't contain
  one, so signing fails with an entitlement error, or the app reports "No App
  Group".
- **Your own developer account:** in the Apple Developer portal create an App
  Group (Identifiers → App Groups), create an explicit App ID with the **App
  Groups** capability and that group assigned, then create a provisioning
  profile for that App ID. Sign the IPA with that profile, keeping the App
  Group entitlement.

## Build and signing

`./build.sh` compiles an arm64 binary and ad-hoc signs it with an App Group
entitlement (`group.cz.kolbi.wqfiles`). The technique needs an App Group, so
re-sign with a tool that keeps one; the app uses whichever group it actually
receives and shows it at the top of the **Log**. If it reports "No App Group",
the signer dropped it.

The deployment minimum is iOS 27.0. Builds first run the host regression suite,
then stage and validate the archive, metadata, signature and App Group before
replacing `WQFiles.ipa` in the project directory. Set `WQ_SKIP_PREFLIGHT=1` for
fixture builds that do not have a test tree. For a separate output, set
`WQFILES_FINAL_IPA` to an absolute path in an existing directory. The source
updater validates the IPA's embedded metadata before atomically replacing
`source.json`; its version/build arguments must match the artifact, and an
existing release description is preserved when no new notes are supplied.

## Regression tests

Run `./tests/run_all_tests.sh` on macOS with Xcode and Python 3. It runs twelve
portable Foundation fixture executables, the Python release fixtures, static
browser checks, and strict iOS arm64 compilation/linkage. Logs and generated
files stay under `.work/tests/`; the existing IPA is not replaced. With only
Command Line Tools installed, set `WQ_SKIP_IOS_CHECK=1` to run the host tests.
Set `WQ_ASAN=1` to compile the host fixtures with AddressSanitizer.

These tests use disposable files and entitlement/access doubles. They do not
issue sandbox tokens or mutate installed app containers. Real iOS signing,
token issuance, navigation/lifecycle timing, power-loss behavior and app-side
concurrent writes still require supported-device validation.

## Credit and license

- Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query)
  by Taj C (forcequit), GPL-3.0-or-later. This app reimplements it.
- Container enumeration with `fsgetpath`: from
  [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus.

WQ Files is GPL-3.0-or-later (see `LICENSE`).

items.name: mkw-recomp
items.description: Static recompilation of Mario Kart World (Nintendo Switch 2) to a native PC program
items.readme:
# mkw-recomp A static recompilation of *Mario Kart World* (Nintendo Switch 2, version 1.0.0) into a native PC program for Linux and Windows. It needs your own copy of the game, dumped from your own console: nothing of the game is in this repository or in its releases. **It is a recompilation, not an emulator.** The game's AArch64 code is translated to C ahead of time and compiled for x86-64; there is no CPU interpreter or JIT. The GPU is not emulated either: NVN2, the Switch 2 graphics API, is reimplemented on top of Vulkan at the API level, and the game's SM86 shaders are translated to SPIR-V ahead of time. Nintendo SDK functions (`nn::*`) are replaced by name with our own code. ## Status Early, and moving fast. On 09/11/2026: - It boots, plays the intro movies, goes through the menus and races, on Linux and on Windows. - The start screen sets the game up from your copy on your machine (generates and compiles the C, translates the shaders, warms up the pipeline cache) and holds every setting: display, graphics quality, controls, hacks. - Races run at about 30 fps on a Radeon 660M at 720p and below that on a GTX 1050 Ti at 1080p; 60 fps is the goal. Below 60 fps, choose Settings > Screen > Frame rate > 30: the Automatic one (the console's) flips between 60 and 30 for now and the race runs in slow motion. See [Performance](#performance). - Known problems: a few menus (mode, character and vehicle select) still need work, the kart's shadow misses a frame now and then, some audio cuts during movies, and on some AMD drivers the GPU can hang. There is no online play. ## Roadmap The main open work, in order; the details are in [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md). - **60 fps in races.** Today a race frame is a serial chain: the game finishes its frame (~3 ms\*), then the Vulkan back end records the game's big submit (~19 ms\*), then the GPU runs it (~10 ms\*), and only then does the next frame start. Recording is on the critical path, so the work is recording with less CPU: dynamic state only when it changes, draw caches across frames, parallel recording, and a faster game thread. - **The picture as on the console**: the last shader translator bugs, the kart's shadow, push constants, zero Vulkan validation errors. - **Every menu checked** against the console: mode, character and vehicle select are next. - **No GPU hangs** and less GPU memory, then loading without stutter and a Linux package for non-rolling distributions. \* Measured on 09/11/2026 on our test machine: Radeon 660M APU (Ryzen 5 7535HS), Linux, 720p internal resolution. ## Performance Measured frame times, each with its date, are in [docs/performance.md](docs/performance.md). To add your machine, open a [performance report](https://github.com/adriadam10/mkw-recomp/issues/new?template=performance.yml): it goes into the table with the date of the report. | Date | GPU | Internal resolution | Race frame time | |---|---|---|---| | 09/11/2026 | Radeon 660M (Linux, RADV) | 720p | 31-33 ms | | 09/11/2026 | GTX 1050 Ti (Windows) | 1080p | 42-45 ms | ## Playing

1. Dump Mario Kart World 1.0.0 from your Switch 2 (`exefs/` and `romfs/`, decrypted). 2. Download the launcher for your system from [Releases](https://github.com/adriadam10/mkw-recomp/releases): on Linux the `.AppImage` (it keeps the game it builds in `~/.local/share/mkw-recomp`; glibc 2.31 or newer: Debian 11, Ubuntu 20.04, SteamOS and later), on Windows the `.zip`, unpacked into a folder. Either needs about 30 GB free. 3. Run the AppImage (`chmod +x` first) or `mkw.exe`, open **Game files**, point it at your dump and press **Prepare**. The first setup takes a while (it compiles the whole game and downloads NVIDIA's `nvdisasm` and `ptxas`, 84 MB on Linux and 126 MB on Windows, to describe the shader encoding on your machine); after that, **Play**. Requirements: x86-64 CPU with AVX2, a GPU with Vulkan 1.3 (`VK_EXT_mesh_shader` recommended; without it, task and mesh shaders run as compute), 16 GB of RAM recommended. ## Building from source Linux, with `uv`, `clang`, `lld`, `ninja`, SDL3, Opus, libvpx, zstd, xxHash, the Vulkan headers and VMA 3.4.0 (details in [tools/build/README.md](tools/build/README.md)). Put your dump in `game/` (`game/exefs`, `game/romfs`) or set `MKW_GAME=`, then from the repo root: ```sh uv run python recomp/gen.py --exefs game/exefs --out build/generated --jobs 8 --patches recomp/patches-mkw.txt uv run tools/shaders/extract.py && uv run tools/shaders/translate.py uv run tools/build/build.py # build/mkw; --target windows builds mkw.exe with llvm-mingw build/mkw ``` Translating the shaders needs the SM86 encoding specification, generated from NVIDIA's `nvdisasm` (not shipped): see [tools/shaders/README.md](tools/shaders/README.md). Everything generated goes to `build/`, never to git. | Folder | Contents | |---|---| | [recomp/](recomp/README.md) | The generator: AArch64 → C | | [runtime/](runtime/README.md) | What plays the console: kernel, memory, SDK replacements, NVN2 over Vulkan, audio, input, menus and launcher | | [sm86/](sm86/README.md) | The shader translator: SM86 SASS → GLSL → SPIR-V | | [tools/](tools/README.md) | Analysis, setup, build, game runs and diagnostics | | [docs/](docs/README.md) | Research, sources and performance | | `.github/` | CI, issue and pull request templates | At the root: `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock` (the Python environment of the tools), `.gitignore`, `LICENSE`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` (each release's changes, its notes), `AGENTS.md` (a guide for coding agents). ## Design decisions (30/10/2026) | Topic | Decision | Why | |---|---|---| | CPU | AArch64→C lifter based on [totk-pc-recomp](https://github.com/valentderah/totk-pc-recomp)'s (MIT), extended to ARMv8.1-8.3: LSE atomics, CAS, LDAPR; PAC as identity, MTE tags as 0 | Same engine family as MKW, and it already scales to a large executable | | System | The SDK's `nn::*` functions replaced by name; signatures from the mangled names of `main`'s 1 289 imports | No console services to emulate | | Graphics | NVN2 over Vulkan: 529 of its 699 functions share their name with NVN1 (signatures known from totk-pc-recomp and nxnative); 170 are new | Recompilation, not GPU emulation | | Shaders | Our own SM86→SPIR-V translator, offline, with a decoder generated from the DocumentSASS / nvsass-disassembler specification | Covers mesh/task and what Maxwell lacks | | Optional Switch 2 features | DLSS, HDR, ray tracing and touch behind options, off by default; off, their NVN2 functions exist but do nothing so the game keeps its normal path | Console hardware extras, not needed to play | | Defaults | The console's look and resolution; lower settings are options | The player chooses | ## How it was made This port was written with [Claude](https://claude.com/claude-code) (Anthropic's coding agent) doing most of the typing, under my direction, in about ten days of full-time work: 489 commits from 30/10/2026, every one of them reviewed, measured or tested before it went in. It was not one prompt and done. Behind it: - **Method more than prompts.** Every change of performance was measured with an A/B inside the same run (two runs of the same build differ by up to 12 ms per frame); every rendering fix was checked against the console's own image; shader translator changes are tested off the GPU on every one of MKW's 11 561 programs before a game run; frame captures replay the back end in seconds without the game. The rules that came out of mistakes are written down and enforced by scripts, so the same mistake does not happen twice. - **What I had learnt before.** The recompiler and the runtime grew out of [totk-pc-recomp](https://github.com/valentderah/totk-pc-recomp) and its Linux port, and out of my earlier work on other recomps (SavageWindRecomp, smo-recomp): the lifter, the launcher and the setup that builds the game on the player's machine, the button icons, the shader control flow. As a maintainer of [AnyPS5](https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5) I learnt how to translate GPU shaders faithfully, run mesh shaders as compute on GPUs that lack them, and keep a large project honest with checks and measurements. - **The community's research.** [eden-nx2](https://git.eden-emu.dev/Takoroka/eden-nx2)'s notes on Switch 2, NVIDIA's SASS encoding as documented by DocumentSASS and nvsass-disassembler, Ryujinx and Mesa NAK for shader semantics, and the other Switch 2 ports listed in the sources. ## Licenses and credits This project is under the [MIT License](LICENSE). Code taken from other projects keeps its own license, next to it (`LICENSE.*` files in [recomp/](recomp/), [runtime/](runtime/), [sm86/decode/](sm86/decode/) and [runtime/third_party/](runtime/third_party/README.md)): totk-pc-recomp, nvsass-disassembler, Dear ImGui, bc7enc, AMD FidelityFX FSR 1 and Roboto. Every source used, with its license and what was taken from it (code from MIT projects only; from GPL projects, ideas only), is listed in [docs/research.md](docs/research.md#sources). Mario Kart World is © Nintendo. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, contains no game code or assets, and does not help to obtain them. ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Bugs and performance reports go to [Issues](https://github.com/adriadam10/mkw-recomp/issues), questions to [Discussions](https://github.com/adriadam10/mkw-recomp/discussions).

items.readme:
# lunar-for-roblox-decompiled

Decompiled output for Lunar for Roblox 1.0.16 (the Roblox launcher by
Moonsworth, not the Minecraft Lunar Client) - the Electron app, the NSIS
installer around it, and the native DLLs it ships with.

## Layout

- `src/` - main / preload / renderer bundles, cleaned up
- `installer/` - the NSIS script dumped to text, plus the uninstaller's
- `native/` - decompiled output (`.c`): `owutility*`/`integrity.c` up top,
  `installer/`, `addons/` and `chromium/` for the rest
- `docs/` - index of IPC channels/services, bundle outlines, owutility notes
- `tools/` - the scripts used to pull it apart
- `build/` - source + script to rebuild a portable exe (see `BUILDING.md`)

## Reproducing

```sh
# installer blocks + script dump
python tools/extract_nsis.py lunar-for-roblox-1.0.16-setup.exe out/
python tools/nsis_dump.py lunar-for-roblox-1.0.16-setup.exe script.txt

# the actual app payload (dead servers now, use a local copy - see BUILDING.md)
tar -xf lunar-for-roblox-1.0.16-x64.nsis.7z
npx @electron/asar extract resources/app.asar app
```

All code here belongs to Moonsworth / Overwolf / whoever wrote it
